template: Prohibition on the Sale or Use of Coordinated Pricing Algorithms to Set Rents or Manage Occupancy Levels applies to this address. Source: Berkeley Municipal Code Chapter 13.63 (§§ 13.63.030, 13.63.040), as amended by Ordinance No. 7,992-N.S.; as of 2025-12-31. Not legal advice.
rewrite: At this address, it is not allowed to sell or use coordinated pricing algorithms to set rents or manage occupancy levels. This is based on Berkeley Municipal Code Chapter 13.63 (§§ 13.63.030, 13.63.040), as amended by Ordinance No. 7,992-N.S., as of 2025-12-31. Not legal advice.
